title: Everyday Phrases — A Day on the Slopes
scene_zh: 滑雪的一天 · 情境對話
title_quote: We finally made it to the mountain!
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】⛷️ 實用滑雪必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Day on the Slopes
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用滑雪的一天情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從買票、租雪服雪鞋雪板、挑頭盔護目鏡，到搭纜車上初級道、學比薩式剎車、摔倒再爬起來，再到中級道連轉、和朋友比速度、玩雪圈、木屋喝熱可可，最後日落收板、還裝備、泡熱水澡、全身痠痛相約明天再戰，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Day on the Slopes phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering lift tickets, renting skis, boots, jackets, helmets and goggles, riding the chairlift, learning the snowplow, falling and getting up, linking turns on the intermediate run, racing a friend, snow tubing, hot chocolate in the wood hut, then the sunset last run, returning gear, a hot bath, sore muscles and plans for tomorrow. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We finally made it to the mountain!
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈfaɪnəli meɪd ɪt tu ðə ˈmaʊntən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at all that snow up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ɔl ðæt snoʊ ʌp ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你看上頭積了那麼多雪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air is so cold and clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr ɪz soʊ koʊld ænd klin/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的空氣又冷又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe it in — it wakes you up.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ɪt ɪn ɪt weɪks ju ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we get our ski passes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi ɡɛt ˈaʊər skaɪ ˈpæsɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ticket window is on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtɪkɪt ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ɑn ðə lɛft/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a pass for the lift?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə pæs fər ðə lɪft/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one pass covers every lift.
dialogue.zh: 要，一張票所有纜車通用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a full-day pass?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə fʊl deɪ pæs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty dollars for one single day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy two days instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days works out cheaper per day.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz wɜrks aʊt ˈtʃipər pər deɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take the two-day one.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl teɪk ðə tu deɪ wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart — now we can come back.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣我們還能再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I pay on my phone here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ peɪ ɑn maɪ foʊn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡可以用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just tap the little machine.
dialogue.zh: 可以，碰一下那台機器就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. The screen says approved.
dialogue.zh: 好了，螢幕顯示付款成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the receipt in your pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we need gear, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rental shop is next door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to book gear online?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tu bʊk ɡɪr ˌɑnˈlaɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can rent it here today.
dialogue.zh: 今天直接在這兒租也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't own any ski clothes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They rent warm jackets too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This red jacket looks warm enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it on — sizing runs small.
dialogue.zh: 試穿一下，這裡的碼偏小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The zipper is stuck a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the fabric while you zip.
dialogue.zh: 拉拉鏈時把布往外帶一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better. It fits great now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also keeps the wind out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I really need snow pants?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, jeans get wet in minutes.
dialogue.zh: 要，牛仔褲幾分鐘就濕透。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These black ones feel pretty stiff.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They soften once you start moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about thick warm socks inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No — one thin pair fits better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that, exactly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight socks make cold toes.
dialogue.zh: 襪子太緊，腳趾反而發冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a tip I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most beginners get that one wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which helmet should I pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose one that sits snug, not loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃuːz wʌn ðæt sɪts snʌɡ nɑt luːs/
dialogue.zh: 選戴著貼合不晃的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this one feel too tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should stay put when you shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd steɪ pʊt wɛn ju ʃeɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'll wear this helmet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never ski without one, okay?
dialogue.zh: 滑雪千萬不能不戴頭盔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are goggles really necessary?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun off the snow hurts your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn ɔf ðə snoʊ hɜrts jɔr aɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like these clear lenses better.
dialogue.zh: 我更喜歡這片透明鏡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're good in cloudy light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My glasses fog up inside them.
dialogue.zh: 我戴眼鏡在裡面會起霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This model fits over glasses.
dialogue.zh: 這款能直接罩在眼鏡外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect — that solves my problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them with the soft cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I clean the lens with my fingers?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ klin ðə lɛnz wɪð maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, fingers leave oily marks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now for the boots, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the hardest part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pair is way too big.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your heel must not lift up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I check that in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ tʃɛk ðæt ɪn hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand on your toes and push forward.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ɑn jɔr toʊz ænd pʊʃ ˈfɔrwərd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This blue pair feels just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snug now means perfect later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The buckles are hard to close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clip the bottom ones first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my toes touch the front?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when you stand up straight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking in these feels so funny.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk flat, like a little penguin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need poles right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip them for your first day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not? Everyone else has them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They mess up balance at first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I can borrow yours later.
dialogue.zh: 也許晚點借你的用一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but keep your wrists strapped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What size skis should I take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand one up beside your arm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These reach my chin exactly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That height is right for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these all-mountain skis?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, great on packed snow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do my boots attach here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toe in first, then press your heel.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊ ɪn fɜrst ðɛn prɛs jɔr hil/
dialogue.zh: 前端先卡進去，再壓腳跟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That click sounded really loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The click means it's locked in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get my foot out?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt maɪ fʊt aʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lever your heel up with a pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvər jɔr hil ʌp wɪð ə poʊl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the binding set too tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The staff set it for your weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stæf sɛt ɪt fər jɔr weɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to sign anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just this short rental form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a deposit on the gear?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə dɪˈpɑzɪt ɑn ðə ɡɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty, refundable when you return it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I break something?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them right away, don't hide it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm raɪt əˈweɪ doʊnt haɪd ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave stuff in a locker?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi liv stʌf ɪn ə ˈlɑkər/
dialogue.zh: 東西能放在儲物櫃裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you need one quarter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, gear done. What's next?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's find the lift to the hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts faɪnd ðə lɪft tu ðə hɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我們去找上小坡的纜車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lift line is really long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll move fast, so don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we scan our pass again here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi skæn ˈaʊər pæs əˈɡɛn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這兒還要再刷一次票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap it at the small gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp ɪt æt ðə smɔl ɡeɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I clip my skis?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the little metal footrest.
dialogue.zh: 掛在那個金屬小腳踏上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bar came down on my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɑr keɪm daʊn ɑn maɪ koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 壓桿放下來壓到我衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift it once, then let it rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ɪt wʌns ðɛn lɛt ɪt rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 抬一下，再讓它輕輕落下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chair feels so high off the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tʃɛr filz soʊ haɪ ɔf ðə ɡraʊnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean back and enjoy the view.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the whole town is below us.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə hoʊl taʊn ɪz bɪˈloʊ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 看，整個小鎮都在我們腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty scary and pretty amazing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep my skis on?
dialogue.zh: 我的板子要一直穿著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take them off at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs teɪk ðɛm ɔf æt ðə tɑp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to swing my legs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tu swɪŋ maɪ lɛɡz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them still, close to the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm stɪl kloʊs tu ðə bɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My scarf is hanging way down.
dialogue.zh: 我的圍巾垂到下面去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck it in before it catches.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're at the top already.
dialogue.zh: 我們一下子就上山頂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hop off once the chair slows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which trail is the easy one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green circle on the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This slope looks flat enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for your first glide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boards won't slide at all.
dialogue.zh: 我的板子一點都滑不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point your tips down the hill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now I'm moving fast!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your knees and stay low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I leaning the wrong way?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press your shins on the tongues.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should my hands be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out front, like holding a tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pizza shape is harder than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpiːtsə ʃeɪp ɪz ˈhɑrdər ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 這個比薩姿勢比看著難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the tails out, not the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə teɪlz aʊt nɑt ðə tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 把板尾往外推，不是板頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a V in front, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and keep the tips apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stopped! I really stopped.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your brake. Nice work.
dialogue.zh: 這就是你的剎車，做得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I want to go faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make the pizza smaller, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 那就慢慢把比薩口縮小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are shaking already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal. Rest one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I fell twice, maybe three times.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone falls. It's part of it.
dialogue.zh: 人人都會摔，這是必經之路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I stand up again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put your boards sideways first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I push with my hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plant them behind your hips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I landed right on my tailbone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch. Sit still and brush off snow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ sɪt stɪl æn brəʃ ɑf snoʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safer to fall sideways?
dialogue.zh: 往側面摔是不是更安全？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, never drop straight backward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I roll when I fall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rolling helps kill your speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My goggles filled with snow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift them off and shake it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðɛm ɔf ænd ʃeɪk ɪt aʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone zoomed past me so close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always look down before starting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who has the right of way?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The skier below you, always.
dialogue.zh: 永遠是你下方的滑雪者。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stopped right in the middle.
dialogue.zh: 我剛滑到一半就停住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move off the trail to rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask an instructor for help?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ən ɪnˈstrʌktʃər fər hɛlp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They wait by the lift sign.
dialogue.zh: 他們就在纜車牌那兒等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are group lessons cheaper?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and they're more fun too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people in one group?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four students with one coach.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adult beginners start at nine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, meet by the blue flag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coach says relax my shoulders.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stiffness makes you skid more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, I'm gliding in a straight line.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk aɪm ˈɡlaɪdɪŋ ɪn ə streɪt laɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beautiful! Hold that balance.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I begin a turn?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shift your weight onto one ski.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left side or right side first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the side that feels stronger.
dialogue.zh: 先試你覺得有力的那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I turned! Did you see that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it. That one was clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ɪt ðæt wʌn wʌz klin/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My skis crossed under me.
dialogue.zh: 我兩塊板在腳下打架了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them hip-width apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skiing is harder than I thought.
dialogue.zh: 滑雪比我以為的難多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it one more honest try.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more run, then something hot.
dialogue.zh: 再滑一趟，然後喝點熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a wooden hut below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we walk there instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better keep skiing — it's quicker.
dialogue.zh: 還是直接滑過去，快得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lift let me off too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪft lɛt mi ɑf tu fæst/
dialogue.zh: 纜車把我放下來太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ski away — don't stop there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was I blocking the others?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just glide to the flat side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This green run finally feels easy.
dialogue.zh: 這條綠道我終於滑順了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, show me your best turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɑn ʃoʊ mi jɔr bɛst tərn/
dialogue.zh: 來吧，給我看你最棒的轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snow spray got into my mouth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes like cold clean water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can link three turns now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在能連轉三個彎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's real progress this morning.
dialogue.zh: 這是今天上午真切的進步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to try the bigger hill?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my legs feel strong again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the intermediate slope?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, follow the blue square sign.
dialogue.zh: 對，跟著藍色方塊標誌走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks much steeper from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the gentle left side first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I keep my speed down?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ kip maɪ spiːd daʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn wide before you drop too far.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn waɪd bɪˈfɔr ju drɑp tu fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 在衝下去之前先轉大彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I draw big S shapes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly — never go straight down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My turns feel rushed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the slope. Count one, two.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fər ðə sloʊp kaʊnt wʌn tu/
dialogue.zh: 別急，順著雪道，在心裡數一二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That rhythm helped a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now your skis sound the same.
dialogue.zh: 現在兩塊板聲音一致了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear a soft scraping noise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your edges doing work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use my poles now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the snow as you begin turning.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə snoʊ æz ju bɪˈɡɪn ˈtɜrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 起步轉彎時輕輕點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tapping feels strange on the ice.
dialogue.zh: 在冰面上點杖感覺怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice happens. Slide across it flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do these tracks lead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down to the lodge and parking lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn tu ðə lɑdʒ ænd ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 一路通到大廳和停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone cut across my line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call out "on your left" next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl aʊt ɑn jɔr lɛft nɛkst taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people really say that here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it warns them you're coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at all those bumps ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are moguls. We can skip them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ɑr ˈmoʊɡəlz wi kən skɪp ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那是蘑菇道，我們可以繞開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to try just one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tu traɪ dʒʌst wʌn laɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay loose and absorb with knees.
dialogue.zh: 全身放鬆，用膝蓋當彈簧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bounced right off the trail.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than a hard fall, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過總比重重摔一下好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your turn looked smooth out there.
dialogue.zh: 你剛才那一趟滑得很順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practice, nothing more than that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Race you to the bottom?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if we stay in control.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loser buys breakfast tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'm trying my absolute hardest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. No dangerous tricks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On your mark... go!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You passed me on the last turn!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pæst mi ɑn ðə læst tərn/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個彎你超過我了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rematch later. Catch your breath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is pounding so hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the fun part, right?
dialogue.zh: 這就是好玩的地方，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's ski it once more, slower.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan. Smooth beats fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we try the tubing park?
dialogue.zh: 我們能去玩雪圈滑道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tickets are at that booth.
dialogue.zh: 可以，票就在那個票亭賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a tube the same as a sled?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə tuːb ðə seɪm æz ə slɛd/
dialogue.zh: 雪圈和雪橇是一回事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's round foam, softer and faster.
dialogue.zh: 是圓圓的泡棉圈，更軟也更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we get on the hill?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du wi ɡɛt ɑn ðə hɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour from the first ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A rope pulls us up the hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə roʊp pʊlz ʌs ʌp ðə hɪl/
dialogue.zh: 有根繩子把我們拉上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the handle with both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It yanked me almost off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let the tube do the work.
dialogue.zh: 別硬拽，讓雪圈帶著你滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I'm flying down the lane!
dialogue.zh: 我現在順著雪道飛下去！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your feet up off the snow.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jɔr fit ʌp ɑf ðə snoʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spun around twice up there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You looked like a top spinning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that kid go past?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ðæt kɪd ɡoʊ pæst/
dialogue.zh: 你看到剛才那小孩衝過去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids fear nothing on a tube.
dialogue.zh: 小孩玩雪圈天不怕地不怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one more ride. Then we stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn mɔr raɪd ðɛn wi stɑp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hurry — the line is growing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My gloves are soaked through.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hut has a drying rack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells like wood smoke inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best smell on the whole mountain.
dialogue.zh: 整座山上最好聞的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit by the fireplace?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That bench is free right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hot chocolates, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With whipped cream on top?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and plenty of cream.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will be nine dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup warms my cold hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the milk is hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they serve hot soup here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chili is famous here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to try the chili.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order at the far counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything on the menu costs more.
dialogue.zh: 菜單上的東西都不便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mountain prices, sadly. Eat slow.
dialogue.zh: 山上的價格就這樣，慢慢吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone shows twenty percent left.
dialogue.zh: 我手機只剩百分之二十電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a charger by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold kills batteries so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine died until I warmed it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn daɪd ʌnˈtɪl aɪ wɔrmd ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我的也關了機，回暖後才復活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look outside — dark clouds came.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snow is starting, one flake at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /snoʊ ɪz ˈstɑrtɪŋ wʌn fleɪk æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 開始下雪了，一片一片的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the lifts stay open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unless the wind gets worse.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can barely see the flags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay on the wide marked trail.
dialogue.zh: 留在有標誌的寬雪道上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try your yellow lenses?
dialogue.zh: 我能試試你的黃色鏡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Now the bumps stand out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a pole on the trail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ə poʊl ɑn ðə treɪl/
dialogue.zh: 有根雪杖被丟在雪道上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick it up and hand it to staff.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ɪt ʌp ænd hænd ɪt tu stæf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much longer can we stay out?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈlɔŋɡər kən wi steɪ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我們還能在外面滑多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lifts shut at four sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let's take one last run.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if we ride the gondola up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf wi raɪd ðə ˈɡɑndələ ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why the gondola instead of chairs?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不坐吊椅，改坐吊廂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's warm inside, glass and windproof.
dialogue.zh: 裡面有玻璃，擋風又暖和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is dropping behind the ridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn ɪz ˈdrɑpɪŋ bɪˈhaɪnd ðə rɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The snow turned pink and gold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything looks quieter now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people already went down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we do this one more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi du ðɪs wʌn mɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這條道我們能再滑一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but start now, not later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light is going so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your goggles clear of frost.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The snow feels icy in the shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə snoʊ filz ˈaɪsi ɪn ðə ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 陰影裡的雪結冰變硬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shorten your turns a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see my breath now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover your neck with the buff.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was that loud whistle?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're closing the upper lifts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we make it down in time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi meɪk ɪt daʊn ɪn taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just barely. Look behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chairs are moving away empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the signal to pack up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs feel like jelly here.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿現在像果凍一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk slow to the flat area.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I unclip these boots?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lever up at the back, firmly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One came off. The other stuck.
dialogue.zh: 一塊下來了，另一塊卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twist your knee gently to the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɪst jɔr niː ˈdʒɛntli tu ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋輕輕往旁邊轉一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, both free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry your skis on one shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the return counter?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the arrows on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line is short, thank goodness.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better have your receipt out now.
dialogue.zh: 最好現在就把小票拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they check the skis for damage?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ tʃɛk ðə skaɪz fər ˈdæmɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 他們會檢查板子有沒有壞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick look, then they stamp it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any scratches on the base?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one scratch from a rock.
dialogue.zh: 只有一道被石頭刮出的痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they charge me for that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that's just normal wear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got my deposit back today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty dollars, exactly as promised.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I left my gloves in the locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft maɪ ɡlʌvz ɪn ðə ˈlɑkər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I grabbed them; here you go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a real lifesaver.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'd do the same for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My helmet left a red mark.
dialogue.zh: 頭盔在我額上壓出一道紅印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fades in about ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a bruise on my arm.
dialogue.zh: 我胳膊上出現一塊淤青。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice it when we get back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get dry clothes somewhere?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The changing room is past the café.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ rum ɪz pæst ðə kæˈfeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's warm in here at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hair is still dripping snow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Socks feel like heaven after boots.
dialogue.zh: 脫了雪鞋穿襪子像上了天堂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I never appreciate shoes enough.
dialogue.zh: 我從來沒那麼感謝鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every muscle aches right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hot bath fixes most of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɑt bæθ ˈfɪksɪz moʊst ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 泡個熱水澡能解決大半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our room has a deep tub.
dialogue.zh: 我們房間有個很深的浴缸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the bath salts from my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə bæθ sɔlts frʌm maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 把我包裡的浴鹽倒進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water is almost too hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it down just a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, this is the best part.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See how the knots come loose?
dialogue.zh: 看，僵硬的肩頸鬆開了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thighs still twitch a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stretch them before you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me that calf stretch again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press your foot on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one really releases it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold twenty seconds, then switch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want dinner downstairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if there's a fire nearby.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A table by the stove, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free if you wait five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fri ɪf ju weɪt faɪv ˈmɪnɪts/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could eat the whole menu.
dialogue.zh: 我餓得能吃完整張菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the warm bread, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This noodle soup smells perfect.
dialogue.zh: 這碗麵湯香得無可挑剔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skiing gives you an honest hunger.
dialogue.zh: 滑完雪的餓才是最真實的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you hand me the salt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, and take the pepper too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do your knees feel tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚你膝蓋感覺怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stiff, but nothing serious.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine hurt on every single stair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow you'll walk like a robot.
dialogue.zh: 明天你會像機器人一樣走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A robot with a big smile.
dialogue.zh: 一個笑得合不攏嘴的機器人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You loved every minute of it.
dialogue.zh: 你其實每一分鐘都很享受。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was your favorite moment?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last run in the pink light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst rʌn ɪn ðə pɪŋk laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 夕陽粉光裡那最後一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same one. Magic at that hour.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，那個時段像魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We should wake up early again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we go back tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — your pass still works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set an alarm for seven, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six thirty if we want good parking.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈθɜrti ɪf wi wɑnt ɡʊd ˈpɑrkɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six thirty it is. I'm brave.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pack your bag by the door tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæk jɔr bæɡ baɪ ðə dɔr təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need wax or new gloves?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid wæks ɔr nu ɡlʌvz/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要打蠟或新手套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop opens before the lifts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm so sleepy I can barely talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm soʊ ˈslɪpi aɪ kən ˈbɛrli tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 我困得話都快說不出了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good tired, the best kind.
dialogue.zh: 這是幸福的疲憊，最棒的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the lamp, would you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Sleep well, champion.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you on the slopes tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring the hot chocolate next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ ðə hɑt ˈtʃɑklət nɛkst taɪm/
